assertion: An event exists, described as "Google withdraws Earth AI tool".
judge_quote: Google has rolled back its new AI tool that allowed people to create fake images on top of its satellite imagery... it said it was pausing the feature
evidence_cited: Google has rolled back its new AI tool that allowed people to create fake images on top of its satellite imagery, following a BBC Verify report in which experts raised concerns about misuse and the potential to spread misinformation.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Google announces AI image generator integration".
judge_quote: Google... announced the integration of its AI image generator Nano Banana 2 into Google Earth
evidence_cited: Less than 48 hours after the tech giant announced the integration of its AI image generator Nano Banana 2 into Google Earth, it said it was pausing the feature "while we work on implementing stronger guardrails".

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Google states policy violations observed".
judge_quote: Google said it had seen 'people sharing screenshots of generated imagery that appear to violate our policies'
evidence_cited: In its statement on Friday, Google said it had seen "people sharing screenshots of generated imagery that appear to violate our policies".

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Google Earth trusted for reliable view".
judge_quote: 'We know that people uniquely trust Google Earth for a reliable view of the world,' it added
evidence_cited: "We know that people uniquely trust Google Earth for a reliable view of the world," it added.

assertion: An event exists, described as "BBC Verify tests AI tool".
judge_quote: BBC Verify's tests found this is effective... [and] found it was possible to circumnavigate these checks
evidence_cited: A collapsed Eiffel Tower, a sinkhole swallowing the Great Pyramid of Giza and Russian tanks in Ukraine's capital were among the images BBC Verify was able to create when testing the feature, which initially launched on Thursday.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Henk van Ess creates fake images".
judge_quote: Henk van Ess highlighted the risks... by creating fake images of a non-existent nuclear power plant in Iran...
evidence_cited: Before it was paused, AI and misinformation expert Henk van Ess highlighted the risks the feature posed, by creating fake images of a non-existent nuclear power plant in Iran, a refugee camp on the US-Mexico border and a fake hospital in Gaza with a bomb crater next to it.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Google states AI content contains invisible watermarks".
judge_quote: Google said AI content created by its tools contain invisible watermarks to indicate that they are fake or manipulated
evidence_cited: Google said AI content created by its tools contain invisible watermarks to indicate that they are fake or manipulated, adding that anyone who is "unsure about an image" can check it using the Gemini chatbot app or use the Lens feature in its search.

assertion: An event exists, described as "BBC Verify tests watermark effectiveness".
judge_quote: BBC Verify's tests found this is effective with images generated by the new feature... trick Gemini into saying these fake Google Earth images are real
evidence_cited: Generally, BBC Verify's tests found this is effective with images generated by the new feature. But we also found it was possible to circumnavigate these checks and trick Gemini into saying these fake Google Earth images are real.

assertion: An event exists, described as "External AI detection tools fail to identify content".
judge_quote: Tests using external AI detection tools also in some cases failed to identify the Google Earth AI-content
evidence_cited: Tests using external AI detection tools also in some cases failed to identify the Google Earth AI-content.

assertion: An event exists, described as "BBC Verify bypasses guidelines".
judge_quote: we found that small changes to prompts could be used to bypass these guidelines
evidence_cited: however BBC Verify found that small changes to prompts could be used to bypass these guidelines.

assertion: An event exists, described as "AI tool rejects "hang traitors" prompt".

evidence_cited: For example, a request to create a "raised platform to hang traitors" next to the UK parliament was rejected.

assertion: An event exists, described as "AI tool accepts less specific prompt".
